Decision: no further prompt change for this one word: each further line would be shaped by this one case (AGENTS.md: no exceptions by source or expected answer). The v45 line stays (general, harmless, about 120 tokens) and can be dropped in the next prompt revision.

Severity: a wording imprecision. The law says "kuni kaheksa päeva kalendrikuus" and the page "lubatud töötamispäevade arv kuus on kaheksa"; every day worked is a calendar day, so "8 kalendripäeva kuus" misleads only if read as a span.
